messages:
Evan (docs): FYI customer hit 422 when calling POST /v1/deployments. Our API ref example uses `max_replicas` but runtime expects `max_instances`. The curl and SDK snippets both show the wrong field.

Zoe (eng): Ah, `max_replicas` was in an earlier schema. We renamed it to `max_instances` when we unified naming with autoscaling service. Runtime accepts `max_instances` (int) or an `scaling` object {min,max,mode}. Also the response example in docs shows `\{"id\":...}` but the service returns `\{"deployment_ref\":..., \"state\":...}` with 202 on async create.

Cam (sdk): Thanks. I'll update JS/py snippet helpers. Current convenience wrapper maps `max_replicas` and warns, but docs should reflect the canonical field. I'll prepare small SDK PRs with new examples and a compatibility note.

Evan (docs): Draft curl example to replace the old one:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deployments" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","max_instances":4,"resources":{"gpu":"a100"}}'
```

Evan (docs): And the recommended `scaling` object example:
```json
{"model":"redwood-3b","scaling":{"min":1,"max":8,"mode":"cpu"},"resources":{"gpu":"a100"}}
```

Zoe (eng): Also update the OpenAPI response example to 202 and show `deployment_ref`. Add note: "Creation is async; poll GET /v1/deployments/{deployment_ref} for state."

Raj (pm): Customer impact = high (deploys failing). Recommend we: 1) push a docs hotfix, 2) post a short migration blurb in release notes, 3) coordinate SDK releases. Consider a one-release compatibility alias in the controller for `max_replicas` -> `max_instances` with a server warning.

Cam (sdk): I'll open PRs: js-sdk#701 and py-sdk#402 to update examples, add tests for the new field, and a note about deprecation. Will link the SDK PRs from the docs change.

Evan (docs): Opening docs PR now with OpenAPI patch, curl + code snippets, and a migration blurb: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4605 (cc @Zoe @Cam).

docs-bot: PR opened by Evan (docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4605 labels: docs,hotfix

Zoe (eng): I'll add a small compatibility shim in the controller and add unit tests. Will log a deprecation warning when `max_replicas` seen. ETA a few hours.

Cam (sdk): Once docs PR merges I'll open SDK PRs and update the sample in `examples/deploy`. Also will bump the snippet versions in the docs site.

Evan (docs): Action list: 
- [x] Update OpenAPI schema (max_instances + scaling object)
- [x] Replace curl, JS, Python snippets in docs PR
- [ ] Add migration blurb to release notes + link SDK PRs
- [ ] Confirm controller compatibility shim merged then remove alias after one release

Zoe (eng): Controller shim PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controller/pull/1012 (draft). Tests added.

docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4605 (merged by Zoe)
